planets.name: WASP-42 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-42 with a 4.98-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-42 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-42. Its orbit and size follow Southworth et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
